reasoning.trend_analysis:
Revenue has shown consistent positive growth, from 6.89% in 2022 to 5.51% in 2023, indicating a slight deceleration but continued expansion. COGS as a percentage of revenue fluctuated (28.13%, 30.11%, 28.35%), with 2023 returning closer to 2021 levels. Gross Profit margin remained relatively stable around 70-72%. Operating Expense as a percentage of revenue also remained stable, hovering around 42-43%. Operating Income growth was flat in 2022 but rebounded strongly in 2023 (9.46%). Net Income demonstrated significant growth (30.39% in 2022, 79.99% in 2023), with the net income margin improving substantially from 9.31% to 19.37%.

On the Balance Sheet, Total Assets were volatile, decreasing significantly in 2022 before recovering in 2023. Current Assets and Cash followed a similar volatile pattern, though Cash as a percentage of Current Assets remained relatively stable (around 65-68%). Total Liabilities decreased in both 2022 and 2023. Equity, while historically negative, showed a strong trend towards improvement, becoming significantly less negative in 2023. Current Liabilities saw a sharp decrease in 2022, followed by a smaller decrease in 2023.

Cash Flow from Operations and Free Cash Flow were highly volatile, experiencing a sharp decline in 2022 and a robust recovery in 2023. Capex, while fluctuating, remained a relatively small and consistent percentage of revenue.

Net Income is estimated at 70% of Operating Income, reflecting a continued improvement in profitability beyond operating income, albeit at a more moderate pace than the dramatic jump seen in 2023.

For the Balance Sheet, Total Assets are projected using an Asset Turnover (Revenue/Total Assets) ratio of 0.75, consistent with 2022-2023 performance. Current Assets are assumed to be 28% of Total Assets, aligning with the 2023 level. Cash is estimated at 67% of Current Assets, maintaining its historical stability. Total Liabilities are projected at 99.5% of Total Assets, reflecting a continued trend towards positive equity. Current Liabilities are assumed to be 11.5% of Total Liabilities, continuing the recent downward trend.

For Cash Flow, Operating Cash Flow is estimated at 27% of Revenue, reflecting the strong recovery observed in 2023. Capex is projected at -2.0% of Revenue, consistent with recent levels.

The significant improvement in Net Income margin in 2023 suggests enhanced operational efficiency or favorable non-operating factors.
